title: MaCTG: Multi-Agent Collaborative Thought Graph for Automatic Programming

prompt.location: Sec. 4.1: single-LLM baselines receive the BCVPP requirement plus 'Write a set of Python code to finish the project.'

data.source: BCVPP dataset (90 image-processing projects: 30 simple, 50 medium, 10 hard), https://github.com/MaCTG2025/MaCTG

notes: Scoring is execution-based (generated code run on the input image, output compared with the expected output), so a runner plus the repo's expected outputs are needed; Pass@5 needs 5 samples per project. o3-mini-2025-01-31 (Pass@1 63.33%) is a cheaper alternative (mid). Repo contents not verified offline.
